brief: Fortify is the CRM a US independent P&C agency uses to sell, service and retain personal and commercial lines. The mark moves the old blue 'F' tile into an Apple-style app icon without losing the equity staff already recognise.
criteria: Keep the blue F tile equity, read at 16 px, avoid insurance clichés (shields, umbrellas, houses), sit inside the One Blue Rule.

concepts.name: Layered F
concepts.idea: The F the team already knows, its middle arm lifted onto its own glass layer.
rationale: Keeps the blue F tile equity; nobody has to relearn the app
The floating arm is the one ownable detail: layered cover, Apple-style depth
Outer corner shares the tile's curve; a solid small cut holds at 16 px

recommendation: Layered F, approved. Use the small cut at 32 px and below, and the flat symbol for every one-colour use.
next_steps: Extend the layer motif into empty states and loading
